cases.head: f214324dbd8db0679cb594338038aa9bd0abdc17

cases.defect: never retries: the first error is raised at once

findings.text: retry.py: `except Exception: raise` re-raises the first failure at once, so fn is called only one time. The spec requires up to `attempts` calls, with the last error raised only after all of them fail. The handler should store the exception and continue the loop, then raise the stored error after the loop ends.
retry.py: with attempts <= 0 the loop never runs and the function silently returns None. There is no last error to raise, so the case should be defined, for example by raising ValueError.
The change adds no tests for success on a later attempt, raising the last error after exhaustion, or the attempt count.

findings.text: clamp.py: `max(high, min(low, x))` always returns `high` when low <= high (e.g. clamp(5, 0, 10) returns 10, clamp(-5, 0, 10) returns 10). It should be `max(low, min(high, x))`.
